Name: JP's Le Pets - Cats of Balance
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#ff00ff][u][center]Cats of Balance[/center][/u][/color][/size][/i][/b]

[color=#00ff00][size=5][i]You can adopt 10 cats that represent the balance of the world, at Marnie's ranch!!![/i][/size][/color]


[size=4]These cats are more useful than the ones Marnie normally offers you, costing only 5000g (previously 40000g) and are 10% more likely to give you a gift when you pet them (30% when normally it is 20%). 
They all give the same gifts as a normal cat, with the same probabilities, but you will need less hearts to get gifts (1 heart when originally 5). [color=#ff0000]You will still need 5 hearts to receive the most valuable gifts and it is not very often that you receive them. 
[/color]Apart from the appearance of the cats and the occasional extra animation, these cats offer nothing special. 


[list]
[*][color=#ffff00][size=6][b][u][i]In order to adopt you must do one of these two options:[/i][/u][/b][/size][/color]
[/list][list=1]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]Reach 5 hearts with the pet Marnie finds.[/b][/size][/color]
[*][size=4][b][color=#f4f4f4]Rejects the pet Marnie finds [/color]and[/b][/size][size=4][b] wait until day 2 of year 2 to receive a letter from her. [/b][/size]
[/list][b]
[/b][b][i][color=#00ffff]Not much more to add, I hope you like it. [/color][/i][/b][/size]
